ordered_diagnoses: Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Tonsil

facts.raw_span: A 52-year-old Bangladeshi man
1-week history of odynophagia
persistent sensation of a foreign body in his throat
following fish-bone impaction
no visible fish bone
a protruding lesion was observed through the right palatine tonsil
hard, mobile, well-delineated, nontender, and yellowish-white in color
no mucosal ulceration or mass elsewhere in the upper aerodigestive tract
no cervical lymphadenopathy was palpable
a uniform, ovoid calcification overlying the right tonsillar region abutting the mandibular ramus
denied dysphagia, dyspnea, otalgia, or weight loss
moderate tobacco use and habitual betel-nut chewing
